certification.name: CREST Registered Intrusion Analyst
certification.description: Intermediate invigilated exam of 150 multiple-choice questions in 2.5 hours on network intrusion, host intrusion and malware reverse engineering, taken at Pearson VUE centres with Kali Linux and Windows provided. Requires a valid CPIA.
